text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With the Satsuki Sho behind us, the days 
of striving toward the Japanese Derby 
continued.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Winning Ticket, this was the grand 
stage she had always dreamed of.
choice_data_list:
(No matter what it takes, I want her to 
win!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Or at least, that's what I had thought, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, oh. It's just you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry, I had a weird dream... So I 
was just spacing out a bit.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no, it was just a dream, so I'm 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm gonna go warm up!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Satsuki Sho, Winning Ticket 
had been acting a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I cast a worried glance toward 
her—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUUUUD...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to just be jogging lightly, 
but my legs got tangled and I took a 
fall...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha...! I messed up! That scared the 
heck outta me~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry! Looks like you're not hurt 
though, so it's all good!
choice_data_list:
Just to be safe, should we skip training 
for today?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: N-No way!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, I mean, the Japanese 
Derby is coming up so soon, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If you want it to be the best race ever, 
you gotta do a ton of training!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Alright, back to my run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Don't overdo it." Before I could even 
finish adding those words, she had already 
sprinted off in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even during training after that day, she 
still seemed somewhat restless...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!! Pheeewww.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So, time, time, time!! How was my time!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The displayed time was... far worse than 
her personal best.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uggghhhhh! No good, no good at all, this 
won't cut it at aaaallllll!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right, one mooooore round!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket still looks eager to keep 
going, but the sun has already completely 
set, so—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine, totally fine! I can still keep 
runnin'!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between her taking a tumble the other day 
and getting needlessly worked up over her 
lap times, something definitely seems off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Making them train isn't a Trainer's only 
duty.
choice_data_list: Shall we have a little chat?
Want to chat for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Talk...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Hey, I really don't think we 
have time to be taking walks...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's the matter, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...! M-Me... being impatient...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right... Maybe so. I wonder. But, but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer. Lately, I've been having 
this dream."
choice_data_list: What kind of dream is that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —A dream where I lose the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Both Taishin and Hayahide blew right past 
me in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much I ran, I couldn't 
catch up at all, and came in dead last—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"All the fans were so disappointed...!! 
They said, 'That was the worst Derby 
ever'...!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm... scared to run in the Derby right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Neither Taishin nor Hayahide are scared at 
all, so I look like a total idiot being 
the only one...! B-But it's super 
scaryyy~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If I'm... if I'm this scared! There's no 
way I can win the Derby...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What should I dooooo?! Waaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason I fell from rushing was because 
I was scared, and the reason I wanted to 
shave even a single second off my time was 
surely because I was scared, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who doesn't mind losing 
doesn't fear racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Conversely, feeling fear means your 
desire to win is just that strong. In 
other words—"
choice_data_list: You hate losing more than anyone.
You hate losing more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list:
Those feelings will surely become your 
strength during the race.

Those feelings will surely become your 
strength during the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, when it's truly 
painful, the desire to win can become a 
powerful driving force.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list:
The fear you're feeling right now isn't a 
weakness.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's... not a weakness...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And after a moment of silence...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket jumped up into the air!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, you're right!! That's 
totally it!! It's a weapon!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Amazing!! Suddenly, I feel all sparkling 
inside~! I feel like running around a 
whole bunch right now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I feel like I can win!! I feel like—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, you're wrong! I'm gonna win... I am 
definitely winning the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Winning Ticket took a huge, 
deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna... win the 
Derbyyyy～～～～～～～～～～～!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket, howling beneath the 
moonlit sky, was shining brilliantly, just 
like always—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her battle cry, roaring from the depths 
of her gut, echoed powerfully as if 
outshining the twinkling night sky."
